scripts.publish:local: pnpm run build && if [ -n "$GUIDANCE_DIR" ]; then mkdir -p "$GUIDANCE_DIR/lib/third_party/cssomnom/" && cp dist/* README.md LICENSE "$GUIDANCE_DIR/lib/third_party/cssomnom/"; else echo "Error: GUIDANCE_DIR environment variable is not set."; exit 1; fi
scripts.preflight: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:node
scripts.maintain: pnpm update --latest && pnpm run submodules:update && pnpm run codegen && pnpm run fixtures:generate && pnpm run preflight
